description: EXPERIMENT, not commissioned. Commissioned drive + commissioned steering gains with the output clamp opened from +/-0.25 to +/-0.5 and Kd reduced 6.0 -> 2.0. Purpose: halve the module slew time that cos_error_scaling converts into drive lag, without giving finding 9 (unverified position PID wrapping) full motor output. Do not promote this to the default until finding 9 is settled and this has run on the floor.
drive_command_scale_notes: Same as base_pid_commissioned.json, because the scale depends only on the drive gains and those are identical. Still provisional at 1.068: the 2026-08-24 measurement that would have pinned it was contaminated by a curved run (5.8% wheel-speed spread, RL slowest), which biases the recommendation high. Re-measure once the modules are matched.

drive.notes: Feed-forward dominated rather than a conventional PD loop. Kd is deliberately zero: a tested value of 10 caused an audibly harsh 100 Hz torque ripple and rough deceleration during floor testing.

steering.notes: Kp=20 saturates at 0.5/20 = 0.025 turns = 9 deg of error; measured slew error is 23-28 deg, so this is still a saturated (bang-bang) loop, at half output instead of quarter. Kd cut to 2.0 because the derivative term scales with the same clamp: at 180 deg/s a module contributes Kd*0.5 turns/s, which saturates on its own, and the clamp is what has been keeping encoder noise out of the gearbox. A wrap-crossing under finding 9 costs a half-power detour here, not a full-power spin.
